# Mumla for Mac 1.0.1 (45) - Experimental Live Meetings Beta
## New
- A Meetings workspace in the existing tactile light/dark interface. Open it from the menu bar or the full recorder, choose a meeting application and microphone, and explicitly start recording. Microphone-only recording is also available. No bot joins your call. - Local Swedish transcription during recording, with timestamps, source labels, pause/resume, Stop and Save, search, text corrections and clip playback. - Optional speaker separation through a separately downloaded, verified 45 MB model. Without it, the transcript distinguishes microphone and app audio. Speaker labels do not identify people's real names; you can name them yourself. - Clean text, timestamped text, Markdown and JSON exports for use in your own tools. No meeting chat, summary provider, or external transcription service. - Recording is saved in short chunks independently of transcription. You can record now and transcribe later, retry interrupted processing, and recover committed chunks after an interrupted session. Recovery never restarts a mic. - Choose seven-day audio retention after transcription or deletion when transcription finishes. Unprocessed audio remains until it is transcribed or explicitly deleted. Deleting audio preserves the transcript.
Existing dictation hotkeys, auto-paste, clipboard restoration, local text models, and minimal REC/timer mode remain available. A meeting never auto-pastes its transcript. Stop/pause controls are available in Meetings, the full recorder and menu bar; minimal mode remains a click-through indicator.
## Experimental Scope
Meeting capture requires Apple silicon, macOS 14.2 or later, and the direct Mac build. Ordinary dictation still supports the existing macOS 14+ and Intel matrix. Speech recognition remains Swedish-only. Browser capture can include audio from other tabs in the selected browser, so close unrelated playback first.
Live text appears after two completed three-second chunks plus model processing. The first cold model load can take longer. Text and speaker assignments are experimental; verify the transcript against the original before relying on it. This beta does not claim validated Zoom/Teams/Meet quality or speaker accuracy.
Recording requires explicit microphone and system-audio recording permission for the installed app. Recording does not require Accessibility or Input Monitoring; those permissions still serve the existing dictation hotkey and paste workflow. Obtain the participants' consent before recording a real meeting.
## Install And Verify
Use Check for Updates in the direct Mac app, or quit Mumla and replace it with the downloaded notarized app. Existing history, dictionary, settings and models are preserved. Do not run production, development and TestFlight copies together.
For the first meeting test, use a short consented call with headphones. Confirm both MIC and APP meters respond, both sides appear in the live transcript, and Stop and Save retains the text and playback. Treat a missing source as a failed recording check, not silence you can assume was captured.
The automated regression suite covers storage, recording lifecycle, model-independent capture, cancellation/retry, chunk boundaries and overlay ownership. Separate synthetic checks exercise the actual speech/speaker models, common hardware sample rates, and two hours of two-track disk-backed writing/recovery. These are not real-call, permission, long-meeting accuracy or hardware-memory benchmarks.
Real call capture, device changes, clock drift, permissions, VoiceOver, privacy traffic auditing, and live update installation still need target-Mac acceptance. This remains a prerelease, not a stable meeting recorder. No destination-sending feature, iOS update or sandboxed Mac TestFlight upload is included.

# Mumla for Mac 1.0.1 (44) - Tiny Dictation And Text Models Beta
## New And Fixed
- Minimal dictation is now a translucent 104 x 30 point capsule with just a pulsing REC indicator and a minutes/seconds timer. No waveform, stop or discard buttons. Clicks pass through to the app behind it. Release the held trigger key to finish, tap it to stop hands-free recording, or press Escape to cancel. The full Recorder design is unchanged. Errors and the manual-copy fallback retain readable sizes; successful auto-paste still hides the overlay. - Choose Qwen3.5 4B or Apple Intelligence under Settings > Text model. The chosen on-device model handles both optional Format before pasting and manual text previews. Mumla never silently switches providers or uses a cloud fallback. - Formatting preferences can now request bullet or numbered lists. Mumla keeps every original word in order, including names, numeric values and links. It may change punctuation, sentence capitalization and layout, but does not rewrite wording to meet a writing standard. The previous conflicting instruction that blocked lists has been removed. - Settings now says when the model returned unchanged text, rather than claiming no changes were needed. Unavailable Apple models explain the reason, including disabled Intelligence or unsupported language. Invalid output and generation failures still use the saved original.
Format before pasting remains off by default. When enabled, it adds processing time, especially on first use. Original dictations are saved to History before formatting and can be restored. Summaries remain separate, explicit previews; summary preferences do not change automatic dictation or get pasted as a summary.
Qwen requires Apple silicon and the separate approximately 3.1 GB download. Apple Intelligence requires macOS 26+, eligible hardware, Intelligence enabled and a ready model supporting the transcript language. Availability is checked on the device. Intel dictation remains supported without Qwen generation. Reduce Transparency, Increase Contrast and Reduce Motion remain respected.
## Install
Choose Check for Updates in the direct Mac app, or download the notarized ZIP, quit Mumla and replace the copy in Applications. Existing history, dictionary, settings and downloaded models are preserved. Keep Microphone, Input Monitoring and Accessibility enabled. Do not run direct and TestFlight copies together.
This is a direct Mac beta for macOS 14+, on Apple silicon and Intel. Speech recognition remains Swedish-only; meetings and iCloud sync are not implemented. No cloud fallback. Model and library licenses are available in About.
## Testing
The shared/Mac suite completed 283 tests with zero failures and seven optional checks skipped. Real pinned-Qwen evaluations ran separately and passed: four list-preference examples, eight Swedish/English prose cases and a separate summary. Lists preserved amounts, times and negative values. These synthetic cases are not a general model-quality guarantee. Apple model output quality remains unmeasured here because Apple Intelligence was disabled on the test Mac.
Compact overlays were rendered and inspected in light and dark appearances. Integration tests cover provider routing, cancellation, original retention, clipboard restoration, changed focus, successful-paste dismissal, click-through recording and interactive copy fallback. Real microphone timing, live updater installation and cross-app dictation remain target-Mac acceptance checks. iOS and sandboxed Mac TestFlight are unchanged by this release.

# Mumla for Mac 1.0.1 (43) - Minimal Dictation And Local Formatting Beta
## New And Fixed
- Settings now has a Format before pasting switch. When enabled, the installed local Qwen text model formats new dictations before auto-paste, using your saved Text preferences. Previously, preferences affected only manual previews in History. The switch is off by default. - Formatting preserves words and their order while adjusting punctuation, capitalization and paragraphs. The original is saved in History before the model runs and can be restored. If the model is unavailable, fails, or changes words, Mumla uses the original and shows the outcome in Settings. - Choose Recorder or Minimal under Settings > Dictation overlay. Minimal is a small indicator with REC, a live waveform, elapsed time and stop/cancel controls. Neither overlay takes focus from the app you are dictating into. - Formatting is cancellable. Cancelling keeps the saved original and does not paste a late result. Successful auto-paste still dismisses the overlay; existing copy-dialog and silent clipboard fallback settings are respected. - Recording startup no longer repeats the focused-field check or scans the microphone list for every pinned-device recording. The overlay appears with a shorter animation. The 250 ms hold-to-talk shortcut guard remains unchanged; a hardware latency improvement has not yet been measured. - Qwen verifies downloaded files before loading, then reuses the loaded model rather than checking all model files again for every request.
Qwen formatting requires Apple silicon and the separate approximately 3.1 GB model download. It adds processing time, especially on first use. Text preferences control formatting, not rewriting or adding words. Summaries remain separate, explicit previews and are never automatically pasted.
## Install
Choose Check for Updates in the direct Mac app, or download the notarized ZIP, quit Mumla and replace the copy in Applications. Existing history, dictionary, settings and downloaded models are preserved. Keep Microphone, Input Monitoring and Accessibility enabled. Do not run direct and TestFlight copies together.
This is a direct Mac beta for macOS 14+, on Apple silicon and Intel. Intel dictation remains supported without Qwen generation. Speech recognition remains Swedish-only; meetings and iCloud sync are not implemented. No cloud fallback. Model and library licenses are available in About.
## Testing
The shared/Mac regression suite completed 269 tests with zero failures and five optional live checks skipped. Both overlay designs were rendered and inspected in light and dark appearances. Synthetic integration tests cover saved prompts, original retention, cancellation, changed focus, clipboard restoration, failed history writes and dismissal after confirmed insertion.
Real microphone-start timing, Swedish model quality, live update installation and cross-app dictation still require target-Mac acceptance. Signing and download verification do not establish those hardware results. iOS/TestFlight is unchanged by this Mac release.
